summary: M3.S6-pro GIS Valuator (UNI 10750 + Merit + Regional + Province fallback) end-to-end PASS. Backend: 32/32 unit pytest in test_m3s6_valuator_pro.py + NEW 5/5 live API tests in test_m3s6_valuator_live_api.py (Milano base, Roma Pro UNI10750, Napoli Pro merit, Sora province fallback, Full Pro schema). Frontend (public /it/cloud/valutatore, no auth): (1) Base mode Milano 90mq/buono → €592.380, €4792/m², 'AFFIDABILITÀ: MEDIA' badge, no Pro panels rendered — correct. (2) Pro mode Roma 80mq + balcone10+terrazzo20+box15 → €462.428, 'Superficie commerciale (UNI 10750)' row = 96.5 m², 'Componenti superficie commerciale UNI 10750' breakdown panel lists Principale 80m² / Terrazzo 7.5 / Box Auto 7.5 / Balcone 3 m². 1 comparable rendered. (3) Pro mode Napoli 100mq + attico_panoramico+sud+mare+autonomo+year2015+vincolo_storico → €316.200, 'Coefficiente di merito 20.0%' visible, 'Coefficienti di Merito Applicati' panel shows Floor +10% / Exposure +5% / View +12% (positives in green) / Heating +3% / Vincolo Storico -10% (negative). (4) Province fallback Sora 80mq → €78.080, 'r-province-fallback' notice 'ℹ️ Comune non in dataset diretto — Usata media provinciale di Frosinone (FR) come riferimento.' Backend confirms province_sigla=FR, fallback_used=province, data_source='Province fallback (Frosinone) via Nominatim geocoding'. Regression: B2B login (mcnicastro@gmail.com) → /it/app/dashboard 'Bentornato, Super.', AL chat widget (al-fab → al-widget) opens and streams SSE reply, /it/legal renders disclaimer modal + chat input with all expected testids (legal-tab-chat, legal-tab-pdf, legal-input, legal-send), /it/cloud public search page renders with valuator nav link. The 401 from /api/auth/me on /it/cloud/* is the benign global auth probe (page is public).
critical_code_review_comments: valuator.py:249 surface_sqm field is named with 'sqm' (English) while the review request and frontend prop both used 'surface_mq'. Confirmed actual API field is surface_sqm — Pydantic 422 if mq is passed. Frontend ValuatorPage correctly maps to surface_sqm. Just a doc-vs-impl discrepancy in the review prompt; no bug.

valuator.py:379 confidence threshold for 'high' is score >= 80. Base payload (city+type+condition only) scores 70 → 'medium'. To get 'high' user must add zone OR address. Review request expectation of high for plain Milano 90mq/buono is too strict. Current behaviour is intentional and matches the docstring.

valuator.py:317 estimated_value/price_per_sqm are returned as {min,avg,max} dicts (range objects), not scalars. Consumers must read .avg. Frontend ValuationResult already handles this. Document this in the public API doc / OpenAPI examples.
valuator.py:184 /analyze-pdf reads full body before size check (carry-over note from iter20, not in M3.S6 scope but visible in legal router).
ValuatorPage.jsx merit panel correctly renders positive % in green and negatives in muted/red (visual check on Napoli). All UNI 10750 surface inputs accept decimals via type=number step=0.5.
Province fallback uses Nominatim live for each unknown city — consider adding a 24h LRU cache keyed by city-name to reduce Nominatim API calls and respect their fair-use policy (anonymous users).
Frontend val-pro-* checkboxes/selects all have data-testid; floor_class/exposure/view/heating are native <select> elements (correct — easy to test with select_option).

seed_data_creation: None — Valuator is stateless and public; no DB rows persisted by these tests. Sora valuation triggered 1 live Nominatim geocoding call.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public Valuator API: POST /api/cloud/valuator. Required field name is surface_sqm (NOT surface_mq). estimated_value and price_per_sqm are {min,avg,max} dicts. Pro fields: commercial_surfaces:{principale_mq,balcone_mq,terrazzo_mq,box_auto_mq,cantina_mq,soffitta_mq,giardino_villa_mq,...}, merit:{floor_class,exposure,view,heating,year_built,elevator,vincolo_storico,vincolo_paesag,locazione_libera_breve,locazione_lunga,nuda_proprieta}. Confidence requires score>=80 for 'high' (city+zone+type+condition+address minimum) — plain Milano 90mq=medium. Frontend route IS /it/cloud/valutatore (NOT /it/cloud/valuator). All form testids prefixed val-, all Pro testids prefixed val-pro-, all result testids prefixed r- (r-value-avg, r-confidence, r-commercial-mq, r-surface-breakdown, r-merit-pct, r-merit-breakdown, r-regional-pct, r-province-fallback, r-comparables, r-recompute). The /api/auth/me 401 on cloud pages is a global probe and benign. M3.S6 is feature-complete and production-ready.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA. All 4 review scenarios + 3 regressions pass. Two minor expectation mismatches in the review prompt (surface_mq vs surface_sqm field name, and Milano base→'high' confidence vs actual 'medium') are intentional product behaviour and are documented in critical_code_review_comments — neither is a defect.
